title: WF03 EXT-01 blocker set: service_task unit suite used stale bpm exports/Zig 0.16 request APIs and exposed configured-header lifetime crash
summary: Resolved EXT01-UNIT-COMPILE-001/002/003 by aligning tests/unit/service_task_test.zig with current bpm exports and Zig 0.16 request APIs, then fixed an exposed configured-header lifetime defect in src/engine/service_task.zig and updated end-node state assertion so EXT-01 unit tests run and pass.

root_cause.details: The unit test referenced obsolete bpm exports and server request APIs incompatible with Zig 0.16. After compile recovery, configured headers appended from transient JSON memory in executeHttpRequest triggered invalid-memory access during HTTP request construction.

changes: Updated tests/unit/service_task_test.zig to use bpm.definition and bpm.transition exports.
Replaced request.head.iterateHeaders() with request.iterateHeaders() and removed try misuse in void CaptureServer.run by handling respond errors inline.
Adjusted transition end-state assertion in TC-EXT-01-U09 to match current COMPLETED semantics (no remaining active tokens).
Updated src/engine/service_task.zig to keep configured header name/value storage owned and alive across client.fetch().

prevention: When adding/extending service_task tests, verify bpm shim export names in src/bpm.zig instead of main.zig exports.
For Zig 0.16 std.http.Server.Request, use request.iterateHeaders() and avoid assumptions from older request head APIs.
Do not append header pointers sourced from short-lived parsed JSON buffers without owning storage for the request lifetime.
